name: Cyberiad Labs
description: Cyberiad Labs is an AI school for everyone, from nurses, teachers and shop owners to students, parents and software engineers. It teaches practical AI skills anyone can use at work and in daily life, and how to use AI tools well: knowing what they can do, where they fail, and how to check what they say. Its online courses are free for individual learners. Cyberiad Labs also works with schools, companies, non-profits and governments to bring its courses to their people.

name: Amara Hub
description: Amara Hub is a think-and-do tank that equips communities and emerging leaders with the knowledge, networks and resources to thrive in a changing world. It provides on-demand and rapid expertise for transformation, Knowledge-to-Impact resources to counter societal challenges, and engagement with different perspectives on the issues that matter.

name: Raijin Tech Hub
description: Raijin Tech Hub crafts state-of-the-art digital solutions that drive innovation and accelerate growth. From custom software to IT consultancy, it delivers excellence that transforms businesses.

name: XyberEdge Technologies
description: Professional IT infrastructure and information security advisory services. XyberEdge helps organisations across Uganda, East Africa and beyond adapt to the evolving tech landscape.

name: Ministry of ICT & National Guidance
description: The Ministry of Information and Communications Technology and National Guidance was established in June 2006 with a mandate of providing strategic and technical leadership, overall coordination, support and advocacy on all matters of policy, laws, regulations and strategy for the ICT sector.

name: National Information Technology Authority, Uganda (NITA-U)
description: The National Information Technology Authority, Uganda (NITA-U) is a government agency established by the NITA-U Act of 2009 as an autonomous statutory body. Its mandate is to coordinate, oversee and regulate the development and delivery of information technology services across Uganda.
